phase_name: Phase 15-7/15-8 Measurement Execution Record Format Validation Rules Design
phase_japanese_name: Phase 15-7/15-8 測定実行記録の形式検証ルール設計
purpose: Design format validation rules for Phase 19-1 and 19-2 measurement execution record templates, specifying structural completeness checks, field type validation, enum constraint enforcement, and mandatory field presence rules

scope_1_structural_completeness_rules.description: Rules to verify all 5 sections of Phase 19-1 and 19-2 templates are present and structurally complete

rule_SC_1.rule: Record must contain all 5 sections: section_1_execution_preamble, section_2_measurement_scope_definition, section_3_measurement_execution_steps, section_4_measurement_result, section_5_post_measurement_actions
rule_SC_1.validation: JSON parse: verify presence of all 5 section keys at top level of template
rule_SC_1.failure_outcome: SECTION_MISSING → route to Phase 19-6 return procedure

rule_SC_2.rule: steps array must contain exactly 7 step entries (step 1 through step 7)
rule_SC_2.validation: len(steps) == 7 AND steps[i].step == i+1 for i in 0..6
rule_SC_2.failure_outcome: EXECUTION_STEPS_INCOMPLETE → route to Phase 19-6 return procedure

rule_SC_3.rule: actions array must contain exactly 5 action entries
rule_SC_3.failure_outcome: POST_ACTIONS_INCOMPLETE → route to Phase 19-6 return procedure

rule_SC_4.rule: phase_15_7_dependency_state block must be present with execution_mode, phase_15_7_execution_record_id, and phase_15_7_integrated_decision_result fields
rule_SC_4.validation: phase_15_7_dependency_state key exists AND has 3 required sub-fields
rule_SC_4.failure_outcome: DEPENDENCY_FIELDS_MISSING → route to Phase 19-6 return procedure

scope_2_mandatory_field_presence_rules.description: Rules specifying which fields must be non-null when a record is submitted as complete

section_2_mandatory: go_criteria: all 5 criterion evaluation_result fields non-null
no_go_criteria: all 4 criterion evaluation_result fields non-null
section_5_mandatory: All 5 actions: completion_status non-null (COMPLETED | SKIPPED_NOT_APPLICABLE | PENDING)

section_2_mandatory: effective_criteria: all 6 criterion evaluation_result fields non-null
not_effective_criteria: all 4 criterion evaluation_result fields non-null

scope_3_field_type_and_format_rules.description: Type and format validation rules for individual fields

rule_FT_2.rule: Must conform to RFC 3339 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (UTC only, no offset)

rule_FT_3.rule: Must be hexadecimal string, minimum 64 characters (SHA-256 output), lowercase

rule_FT_4.rule: Must be valid Base64-encoded string (no whitespace)

rule_FT_5.rule: Must be one of: GO, NO_GO (case-sensitive)

rule_FT_6.rule: Must be one of: EFFECTIVE, NOT_EFFECTIVE (case-sensitive)

rule_FT_8.rule: Must be one of: SEQUENTIAL, PARALLEL (case-sensitive)

scope_4_business_logic_rules.description: Cross-field consistency and business logic validation rules

rule_BL_1.rule: pre_execution_state_snapshot.integrated_decision_before MUST be NO_GO for Phase 19-1. Phase 19-2 may be GO (if Phase 15-7 already complete) or NO_GO.

rule_BL_2.rule: Both Phase 19-1 and 19-2: receiver_validator_permission_before MUST be NOT_EFFECTIVE (Phase 15-8 only can change this)

rule_BL_3.rule: phase_18_6_final_abort_verification_result MUST be FINAL_ABORT_VERIFICATION_PASSED. Any other value is rejected.
rule_BL_3.failure_outcome: ABORT_VERIFICATION_NOT_PASSED → reject record, do not accept execution

rule_BL_4.rule: If all go_criteria evaluation_result=PASS and no no_go_criteria evaluation_result=ACTIVE → integrated_decision_determined=GO. Otherwise must be NO_GO.

rule_BL_5.rule: Phase 19-2 only: if execution_mode=SEQUENTIAL then phase_15_7_integrated_decision_result must be GO (not NO_GO or NOT_YET_EXECUTED)

rule_BL_7.rule: execution_duration_seconds (step 7) must be positive and less than 86400 (24 hours)

scope_5_validation_execution_procedure.description: Procedure for executing all format validation rules against a submitted record

validation_procedure.step_1: Parse JSON: confirm record is syntactically valid JSON
validation_procedure.step_2: Check structural completeness (scope_1 rules SC_1 through SC_4)
validation_procedure.step_3: Check mandatory field presence (scope_2 rules for relevant phase)
validation_procedure.step_4: Check field type and format (scope_3 rules FT_1 through FT_8)
validation_procedure.step_5: Check business logic (scope_4 rules BL_1 through BL_7)
validation_procedure.step_6: Aggregate validation results: PASS (all rules pass) or FAIL (any rule fails)

FORMAT_VALIDATION_PASS.action: Proceed to Phase 19-5 (evidence lock) and Phase 19-3 (cross-validation)

FORMAT_VALIDATION_FAIL.action: Route to Phase 19-6 return procedure with failed rule IDs documented

phase_19_4_completion_criteria: Mandatory field presence rules (Phase 19-1: 5 sections, Phase 19-2: 5 sections) designed
Field type and format rules (8 rules) designed
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
